# 4 bed detached house for sale

> This attractive four-bedroom bungalow occupies a pleasant site on the edge of Knock, approximately 1.5km from the town centre. The property is surrounded by mature gardens to both the front and rear, with ample off-street parking. A block-built garage to the rear provides useful additional storage or workshop space.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 106 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C2
- Lokalita: Ballyhowley, Knock
- Cena: 285 000 €
